messages.author: aae8e9f66c6ae74f
messages.subject: Teething difficulties accessing shiny app
parts:
Hi,

I'm new to Shiny, and have drafted out an app which works nicely on my my machine as prrof of concept. I'd like to share it with some colleagues to get opinions, so have tried to launch it on shinyapp.io. I created a free login for my and apparently lanuched it OK: I can access i on my computer and mobile phone OK, but when I give the address to someone else, it just sits on a 'please wait' page. I think there's some back thing I've got wrong - do I have to do someonthing else to share it more widely? The site I can access is https://beale.shinyapps.io/ProjectMarking, as far as I can see it is only possible for me with my basic account to make this public, so not sure why people can't access it.

Any thoughts?

Thanks!
